Claire (CS): Folks - can we assemble a tiny customer-facing 'warm-pool orchestration' one-pager? needs: recommended defaults, a pasteable config, quick telemetry names to capture, and a 3-question feedback ping. keep it short for kickoff email.
Tomas (Solutions): Good call. call out the decay policy for warm entries and give a backfill job example. customers like copy/paste YAML.
Irene (Eng): Add telemetry suggestions: prefill.hit, prefill.miss, batch.size, stream.open_count. Also recommend alert rules for warm_pool_miss_rate > 5% over 15m.
Claire (CS): Draft recommendations: 1) Warm-pool sizing: start 8 entries at go-live, grow to 40 per tenant if stable traffic. 2) Decay policy: idle eviction after 45m; soft refresh at 15m if reuse detected. 3) Adaptive TTLs: default 1h, PII workflows -> 15m, high-reuse prompts -> 6h.
Don (PM): Renewal/health rubric: flag when (a) 14-day active session count falls by >=25% vs baseline OR (b) day-7 feedback response rate <15% AND NPS <= 6 -> CS outreach. Also missing two smoke tests -> SE alert.
Tomas (Solutions): Pasteable minimal YAML for customers:
```yaml
orchestration:
  warm_pool:
    initial: 8
    target: 40
    idle_eviction_s: 2700  # 45m
    soft_refresh_s: 900    # 15m
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  ttl_overrides:
    pii: 900
    high_reuse: 21600
client:
  debounce_ms: 120
server_batch_ms: 60
streaming_threshold_tokens: 300
```
Irene (Eng): Dev notes (short): - KV key pattern: tenant|env|prompt_sha|schema_v. - Batch window tradeoffs: 20-60ms prioritize tail latency; 60-180ms for better token-efficiency. - Streaming overhead: keeps sockets open, increases CPU per connection; prefer for interactive typing or responses >300 tokens.
Claire (CS): Telemetry checklist for onboarding (send to SE): prefill.hit, prefill.miss, warm_pool_hit_rate, batch.p95_ms, stream.open_count, feedback.submit_count. default alerts: warm_pool_miss_rate >5% (15m), p95_latency > 2x baseline (1h).
Tomas (Solutions): Troubleshooting one-liner customers can run to inspect recent metrics:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant}/metrics?window=10m" | jq '.prefill_hit_rate, .warm_pool_hit_rate, .latency_p95'
```
Claire (CS): Feedback ping (day 7) copy to include in kickoff: "3 quick Qs (30s): 1) Relevance 1-5 2) Latency OK? yes/no 3) Any blocking issues? (short)". If response rate <15% escalate to AE.
Irene (Eng): Recovery tips (concise): 1) If stale outputs after model or prompt schema change: increment schema_v in KV and flush warm entries. 2) If warm_pool_miss spike: temporarily increase server_batch_ms to 120ms and run backfill job. 3) If sustained p95 latency regression: reduce batch window or move to dedicated capacity.
